$schema: Figma component-set contracts snapshot. Regenerate via design/figma/extract.figma.js; consumed by scripts/ds/scaffold-components.mjs.

components.name: Button
components.description:
Every clickable action. loading shows the Spinner; disabled = 50% opacity; focus = 2px border/focus ring outside.
Sync 2026-10: sizes icon-xs (24px, 16px icon: Toast and Banner dismiss, TagTree row menu) and icon-sm (32px, 16px icon) match ui/button.tsx.

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text entry. search = title-bar field (icon + ⌘F); inline-title = the Detail title field, bordered at rest like Textarea, at title size.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line description field (auto-grow is behaviour).

components.name: Field
components.description: Label + control + description + error, so validation always has words.

texts.label: Title
texts.description: Shown on the card and used by search.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Multi-select (tag filter rows). indeterminate = parent tag partly selected.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Binary settings (telemetry consent, AI on/off).

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Single-choice item; card variant hosts rich content (ModelRow).

components.name: Select
components.description: Dropdown choice (sort order, tag category).

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status / count label; status variants use weak fills + coloured text.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Determinate / indeterminate bar. Indicator width = value in code.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate activity for short waits (Hugeicons loading-03, rotated in code).

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Content-shaped loading placeholders; card = MockupCard skeleton, row = ListRow skeleton.

components.name: KeyboardShortcut
components.description: Shortcut hint; boxed in inputs/palettes, plain in menus and tooltips.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Labels icon buttons and explains disabled actions. arrow = edge + end of the body the pointer sits on.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Anchored panel (tag filter, tag suggestions).

components.name: Command
components.description: Searchable list with keyboard nav: inline = tag combobox, palette = ⌘K.

components.name: DropdownMenu Item
components.description: Building block for DropdownMenu rows: icon · label · KeyboardShortcut.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: Action menu panel composed of DropdownMenu Item rows.

components.name: Tabs Trigger
components.description: Building block for Tabs.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Settings section switcher.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Overlay shells. Screens never use these directly — they use Modal / ConfirmDialog / ChoiceDialog.

texts.title: Dialog title
texts.description: A short description of what this dialog is for.

components.name: Toast
components.description:
Transient confirmation with optional action (Undo / Open / Retry). Lives in ActivityDock.
Sync 2026-10: done actions (Moved to Trash, Stashed) use the success variant with the check icon. Undo is a hairline outline button (border/subtle, no fill).

components.name: Separator
components.description: Divider line bound to border/subtle.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description: Styled scroll region with a thin rounded thumb.

components.name: AppWindow
components.description: The window: traffic lights, centred GlobalSearch, SidebarNav (176), content panel with PageHeader + page slot. modal-open adds the scrim; drag-over adds DropOverlay. Slot: page (screen content inside the window, under the PageHeader).

components.name: GlobalSearch
components.description: Title-bar search; ⌘F focuses (⌘K is an alias), 250 ms debounce; zero results → MockupGrid no-results.

components.name: SidebarNav Item
components.description:
Nav row (icon · label · count); child rows hang off a TreeBranch.
Sync 2026-10: a count of 0 is hidden (show-count off), so an empty Starred or Trash shows no badge.

components.name: SidebarNav
components.description:
Primary navigation: My Stash › Starred / All, To sort and To stash (each only when non-empty), Trash, Settings.
Sync 2026-10-23: the wordmark uses title/sm/semibold (Unbounded SemiBold 14) and the logo sits flush left in the brand row (no row padding).

components.name: TreeBranch
components.description: Curved tree connector for nested nav rows; middle continues, last stops at the curve.

components.name: AddMenu
components.description:
Import entry point: Add files… / Add folder… + drop hint. Disabled while an import runs.
Sync 2026-10-23: the trigger is Button base (16px padding, 20px icon) and fills the sidebar column (152).

components.name: PageHeader
components.description:
Breadcrumb title + description + trailing actions.
Sync 2026-10: optional description-action (the Clear link while searching) sits right after the description. The title row wraps, so the actions drop under the title at narrow widths.

components.name: CenteredLayout
components.description: Full-window layout without the sidebar (onboarding, boot, fatal errors): centred 560 content.

components.name: ContentSlot
components.description: Figma-only swappable placeholder. In code this is simply a ReactNode slot — not a component.

components.name: ActivityDock
components.description: Bottom-right stack for toasts, the import card and the DEV debug button.

components.name: DropOverlay
components.description:
Full-window drag-over state; rejected = no PSDs; queued = import already running.
Sync 2026-10-23: inside CoverPanel the title uses title/lg/semibold; display/2xl does not fit the cover.

texts.title: Drop PSDs to add them
texts.description: Files or folders both work. We’ll copy them into your stash folder.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description:
Zero-data / zero-result state with a required primary action. secondary-action is off by default: only add one when it has a real destination (there is no help site).
Sync 2026-10-23: the page variant is 480 wide (384 of text inside 48 padding), so page titles in Unbounded stay on one line.

texts.title: Your stash is looking a little bare
texts.description: Add some PSD mockups and we’ll tuck them away, tagged and sorted into piles.

components.name: LoadingState
components.description: Waiting states: spinner or content-shaped skeletons.

components.name: ErrorState
components.description: What failed, why, and what to do; every IPC {code, message} surfaces here or in a Toast. inline matches Banner: neutral surface-2 card, border/subtle, 3px left accent in border/error (no tinted fill).

texts.title: Couldn’t load your library
texts.message: The database is busy. Try again in a moment.
texts.code: A report is ready to copy if you need to ask for help.

components.name: Banner
components.description: Persistent inline message at the top of a view.

texts.label: Drop files on My Stash to add them

components.name: DropHint
components.description: Cursor-following label shown while files are dragged over a non-droppable area. My Stash and To sort are the only drop targets.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Base content dialog: header, scrolling body slot, ActionBar footer.

texts.title: Skipped files
texts.description: A short line about what this view is for.

components.name: ModalLayer
components.description: Full-window scrim for any dialog. In code: the Dialog overlay (background/overlay).

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: Two-choice confirmation that names the consequence (item, count, size).

texts.title: Break up this pile?
texts.description: Each variant becomes its own mockup in the library.

components.name: ChoiceDialog
components.description: Three-way decision: tertiary (left) · secondary · primary, e.g. Move files · Point only · Cancel, or Resume · Later · Discard. Two-way decisions use ConfirmDialog.

texts.title: Save your changes before closing?
texts.description: You changed the title and 2 tags on “Clay iPhone 15 Pro”.

components.name: FormDialog
components.description: Small dialog with Field(s) and a submit; validation inline, server errors in a Banner.

texts.title: New category
texts.description: Categories group tags in the filter and tag picker.

components.name: ProgressDialog
components.description: Blocking long-running task with progress and cancel.

texts.title: Moving your stash…
texts.description: Copying your PSDs and covers to ~/Pictures/DesignStash.

components.name: Lightbox
components.description: Full-window cover viewer with zoom and prev/next for pile variants.

components.name: FlowModal
components.description:
Large captured modal for Sort + Look it over (1352×822 in a 1512×982 window). Named steps with counts; Finish later always available and always confirms. Screens lay the step body over the empty body area.

Slot: body — the step’s content (sort board, or cover + form + ActionBar) goes inside the modal; padding is built in.
Progress (Look it over): the second track fills to a quarter of the haul. Turn on progress-50, progress-75 or progress-100 (the widest one that is on shows); with all four off it is empty. Code: FlowModal `progress` is 0 to 1. For an exact fraction, drag the `progress-25` rectangle in track-2 on the instance (the plugin API cannot resize it from here).

components.name: CoverImage
components.description: The one way to render a mockup cover (4:3, squircle mask). loading is a plain skeleton block in background/surface-3, never a spinner.

components.name: MockupCard
components.description:
A mockup in any grid: an iOS-squircle container (radius 2xl, 60% corner smoothing; surface-2) with CoverImage, “+N variants” badge, favourite, title and tag line. Hover: the cover zooms ~6% (150ms); Star then ⋯ top-right; along the cover's bottom, over a soft scrim, a full-width primary Open in Photoshop with Edit details (ghost) under it. Edit details, double-click and ↵ open Detail; Space previews; ⋯ = the right-click menu. Selected = border/primary ring. left-behind = the slot a dragged card leaves; group-target = a card being dropped on (drop-hint). pending-review (inbox cards): status badge (show-status) and the +N badge share the top-left row; hover shows one full-width primary button (Look it over in To stash). trash: no star or ⋯, a “Trashed 2 days ago” line, hover Restore with Delete for good under it.
Sync 2026-10: selected and group-target ring is border/selected. The pile badge shows the total (a 3-mockup pile reads 3) with the layers icon. In code, file-name titles middle-truncate (Figma text can only cut the end).

components.name: MockupGrid
components.description: Fill-width wrapping grid of MockupCards. show-add puts AddMockupCard first (on in My Stash › All only). loading = 10 skeleton cards in the same wrap; empty = just the AddMockupCard; no-results / error sit at the top under the toolbar, never vertically centred.

components.name: LibraryToolbar
components.description:
Filter (+count) → TagFilterPopover, active chips + Clear, stats, sort Select.
Sync 2026-10: no item count. The stats text only appears while selecting ("N of M selected").

components.name: TagFilterPopover
components.description: Tag filter: search on top, CategoryPills with live counts, tags grouped by category (scrolls past ~240px). Rules: design/specs/library.md. Tags are two tiers (category, then tag), so the list is flat. Each group starts with an "All in <category>" row: ticking it filters by the whole category and disables that category's tag rows (state=category-picked); hidden while searching.

components.name: FavouriteToggle
components.description: Star on/off on a squircle; overlay on covers, inline in the detail header.

components.name: CopyWidget
components.description:
Bottom-right copy panel (transport only): per-file and overall progress, failures inline, Cancel asks keep or undo, done collapses to a summary.
Sync 2026-10: while copying the title reads "12 of 40 copied" (files that landed, matching the rows marked Copied); counts use thousands separators ("1,204 copied"). The strip carries the headline and this widget the per-file detail. A done card with nothing failed dismisses itself after about 6 seconds and never shows over a flow modal.
Sync 2026-10-23: the title wraps to two lines before it truncates, so “Copying paused · a drive was unplugged” keeps its reason.

components.name: CopyFileRow
components.description:
One file in the copy widget. copying shows a per-file progress bar; finished rows say what happened (copied, duplicate, unreadable, not a PSD).
Sync 2026-10: a done row reads "Copied · 312 MB". A queued row of a cancelled haul reads "Not copied" (detail override).
copying: show-detail swaps the progress bar (show-progress off) for a detail line, like "Unpacking… · From Cap.zip"; the percentage stays. The code shows the line whenever a copying row is given a detail.

components.name: GroupCard
components.description: A proposed pile or the Standalone tray, as a drop zone of GroupMemberThumbs. Members layout: columns follow the pile width (min tile 128, gap 12), tiles fill their cells. In code: @container on the pile body + grid-cols-2 @md:grid-cols-3 @xl:grid-cols-4 @3xl:grid-cols-5 @4xl:grid-cols-6 @5xl:grid-cols-7 @6xl:grid-cols-8. The header is a band and acts as the pile’s handle: click to select the pile, drag it to move the whole pile. Marquee (like Figma): selects tiles across piles; a pile is only selected once the box covers all its tiles and reaches its header. No confidence badge: we only suggest piles we’re confident about. Header: [folder icon] title · count badge · reason badge · ⋯ — title and badge rules: design/specs/pile-titles.md.

components.name: GroupMemberThumb
components.description: A mockup tile inside a pile on the Sort board. Cover on top, filename in a padded caption bar. Top row: Primary badge (left) and the ⋯ menu (right, on hover). States: idle · hover (cover zooms like the library card) · selected (selection ring + accent caption, Finder-style) · lifted (in hand while dragging) · left-behind (dashed slot where it was) · drop-ghost (where it will land) · pile-target (dropping a tile on it starts a pile).

components.name: CoverPanel
components.description:
Cover in Look it over and Detail. At rest: the image, then a tag row (source tag · optional note · Zoom, always visible). hover: Replace (refresh-01) centred, plus “Use the PSD’s preview” on uploaded covers. drag-over: DropOverlay (the same component as the library). replacing: old cover dimmed with progress. error: standard Banner; the cover is unchanged. none: required CoverDropZone. note/show-note + bars implement the crop rule (design/specs/cover.md). Deck (piles only): show-deck peeks one card behind the cover and shows deck-label (“2 left in this pile”); deck-more adds a second card. Only the mockups still to come are counted; it thins as you go and is not clickable.
Sync 2026-10: the source chip only shows when it says something: “Uploaded”, “Sidecar image” or “Low-res preview” for a small embedded preview. A normal embedded preview shows no chip. A sidecar image is used automatically when the PSD has no embedded preview, so there is no prompt to accept it.

components.name: CoverDropZone
components.description: Required cover drop zone (no cover yet). Drag-over is the shared DropOverlay. Rules: design/specs/cover.md.

components.name: MockupMetaForm
components.description: One title / description / tags editor for approval and detail (detail edits the title in the modal header). No status of its own: in Detail an enabled Save means unsaved changes, and a failed save is an error toast. Dirty state drives the unsaved-changes guard. Code: extract from ApprovalStepper ItemEditor + DetailModal.

texts.hint: AI suggested the title, description and tags. Give them a quick check before you stash it.

components.name: TagEditor
components.description: Tags field with inline add: “+ Add tag” is first and becomes the input in place; added tags append at the end; AI suggestions sit after a divider and move into your tags when accepted. Rules: design/specs/tags.md.

components.name: TagChip
components.description: Tag pill. Solid = your tag, dashed = not a tag yet. removable: × on hover; focus = keyboard ring; marked = selected by ⌫. suggested = AI suggestion (faint dashed outline, orange sparkle only; hover fills like a tag with ✓/×; clicking accepts); thinking = AI still working. new = just added (brand outline). add = the inline “+ Add tag” chip (stronger, longer dash), always first; input = that chip while typing. Rules: design/specs/tags.md.

components.name: ActionBar
components.description:
Footer row: secondary actions left, primary right, optional status text.
Sync 2026-10: in the stepper bar only Back and the primary are filled; Finish later is ghost. Skip for now carries the tooltip "It stays in To stash" (hover in the app).

components.name: VariantStrip
components.description: A pile's variants under the cover (V1a): VariantThumbs on fixed 92px slots from the cover's left edge, an arrow on a fade only at an end with more, and a status row (name · n of N, then the Top mark or Put on top).

components.name: VariantThumb
components.description: One variant in a pile's VariantStrip: its cover in an 84×64 ring, its name, and the crown-03 Top mark when it is the top mockup. shown uses the shared selected ring (border/primary, 2px).

components.name: OnboardingStep
components.description: One onboarding page: StepIndicator, title, body, content slot, footer.

texts.title: Set up on-device AI
texts.body: A small model writes titles and tags for new mockups. Nothing leaves your Mac.

components.name: StepIndicator
components.description: Progress through the 5 onboarding steps.

components.name: PathField
components.description: Where the stash lives during onboarding: friendly path + location, with Choose…. Errors: not writable, already a stash (→ ChoiceDialog), unavailable drive. Settings › My Stash has its own path field with Change….

components.name: HardwareSummary
components.description: This Mac and the model size it can run; warns on Intel and low disk.

components.name: ModelRow
components.description:
One on-device model in the onboarding picker (a radio list): download, pause/resume, verify, installed, failed. Settings › AI model uses ModelCard.
Sync 2026-10-22: installed reads Downloaded, or Built in for Apple’s model. Recommended shows only on the best-fit row.

components.name: MeaningSearchCard
components.description: Meaning search in onboarding’s AI step (D6 option M2, chosen 2026-10-22): its own card under the AI panel, shown whether or not on-device AI is on. The switch is on by default and disabled once the download has started. The status line follows the download (meaningLine in settings-copy.ts).

components.name: ModelCard
components.description:
One on-device model in Settings › AI model, after Handy’s model card. Top: name, In use / Best fit for this Mac tags and one plain line, with quality and speed as five-step bars on the right (orange on the model in use). A divider, then the footer: languages, size on disk (or download size), and the actions. in-use = orange border, Delete. downloaded = Delete · Use this model. downloading = progress, “42% · 18 MB/s · about 3 min left”, Cancel. available = Download. failed = the reason in place, Try again. verifying = indeterminate bar, “Checking the download…”, no Cancel. paused = the languages line becomes the resume note and the button reads Resume. Every action is an explicit button, so nothing clickable sits inside a clickable card (Anton 8.19). Code: replaces ModelRow (manage) in SettingsAiPane.tsx.
Sync 2026-10: quality and speed steps fill with background/primary on every card.
Use disabled (no AI switch) is the Use this model button set to state=disabled, with the tooltip "Turn on AI to use a model.".
Sync 2026-10-22: catalogue is Qwen3-VL 4B, Qwen3.5 9B and Apple’s on-device model. Apple’s card has no Delete and sits under “Built into macOS”. The Meaning search row reuses this card with the bars, the globe and Use this model hidden (MeaningSearchRow).

texts.name: Qwen3-VL 4B
texts.description: Accurate titles and tags at a quick pace. Uses about 4.4 GB of memory while it works.

components.name: ModelPicker
components.description: Onboarding A3 model chooser: HardwareSummary card, then the AI panel: “Use on-device AI” label with the Switch on the right, 3 picker ModelRows inside (Qwen3-VL 4B, Qwen3.5 9B, Apple’s on-device model; model-3 only on a Mac that can run it). ai=off collapses the panel to its header.

components.name: ConsentPanel
components.description: Telemetry disclosure for onboarding (A4): what we collect and never collect, then a “Share anonymous usage data” switch, on by default (opt-out, 2026-10-22). Settings › Privacy shows the same lists in its usage-data accordion. The lists are always visible, whatever the switch state.

components.name: SettingsLayout
components.description:
Settings as a modal over the app (880×760): section list on the left (same selected style as the sidebar), pane title + close, grouped rows (title, real value, control on the right, all inline buttons secondary). Switches that unlock more are accordions. Sections: my-stash · ai-model · tags · privacy · about. Rules: design/specs/settings.md.
Sync 2026-10: destructive inline actions in rows (Empty Trash…, Delete) use error-toned label text.

components.name: TagTree
components.description: Settings › Tags: two tiers, category then tag. Each category is its own grouped container (name, tag count, ⋯) with its tags, use counts and its own Add tag row; a dashed New category row closes the list. No nesting. ⋯ on hover: Rename, Move to, Merge into, Delete. Delete is instant with Undo; Merge and Delete category ask first. Rules: design/specs/settings.md.

components.name: ListRow
components.description: Generic row: media or thumb · title/subtitle · actions. Row actions use the standard secondary button.

components.name: ListGroup
components.description: A titled list: SectionHeader + N ListRows.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.description: Title + count + bulk actions over a list.

components.name: ReconciliationPanel
components.description: Resolve stash drift in a blocking modal (G1), the same grouped rows as Settings. Found in your stash folder: cover thumbnail, Ignore · Add (Add puts it in To sort). Gone from your stash folder: Remove · Relink…. Add all / Remove all per group, one Ignore all in the footer (instant, Undo in a toast), N left and Done (enabled at 0). States: drift · resolving · rescanning / scanning (skeleton rows, never a spinner) · all-resolved.

components.name: ProGate
components.description: Wraps a Pro feature: unlocked renders the child (everything is unlocked in Phase 1); locked shows the lock, a plain Pro tag, one line on what the feature does, and Upgrade. No crown (it means top of the pile) and no Learn more until there's somewhere to learn more. inline or page.

components.name: PileStep
components.description: One mockup in a pile, in PileRail: done (draft ready) · current · todo · skipped. show-connector draws the line to the next step. Rules: design/specs/piles.md.

components.name: PileRail
components.description: The pile you’re working through in Look it over: a recessed well docked to the right of the form, full body height. Head: “PILE n OF m” + the pile’s title; steps slot holds PileStep rows (top mockup, variants, then Review & stash pile). Everything in a pile is a draft until Stash pile, so every step is clickable. Rules: design/specs/piles.md.

components.name: AddMockupCard
components.description:
The add affordance in the library grid: always the first card in My Stash › All (hidden in search, filter and Starred); on an empty library it is the only card. Recessed well with a faint dashed cover, same footprint as MockupCard. Click / ↵ opens the Add menu; dragging PSDs over the window shows DropOverlay. Rules: design/specs/library.md.
Sync 2026-10: the focus state is keyboard only. A mouse click leaves no ring (focus-visible).

components.name: CategoryPill
components.description: Category filter inside TagFilterPopover: All, then one pill per tag category with how many tags match; counts update while you search. Rules: design/specs/library.md.
